description: This project proposes determining the demand experienced by single-family houses after hurricanes by combining visual information from housing facades with deep learning tools. This prediction model is possible because the construction industry develops similar designs for single-family housing. We used the Saffir-Simpson Hurricane, wind scale due to its mapping from descriptors to damage and wind levels.
name: Uncertainty aware AI-based model to estimate wind demand based on observed damage to single-family residential housing
